text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Fan Thanksgiving Festival was bustling 
with visitors. As I strolled through the 
academy grounds taking in the exhibits—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a secluded spot, I found Yamanin Zephyr 
looking bewildered.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Another turning wind... This time from 
over there...
choice_data_list: What are you doing in a place like this?
What are you doing in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. I was so distracted by the 
spring gale that I didn't even notice.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
So many winds are echoing today. The 
valley breeze, the shell-gathering wind, 
the cherry blossom breeze...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"There are so many rustling sounds, I'm 
not sure which one I should listen to..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There certainly are a lot of sounds to 
take in today. I can understand why 
someone as sensitive as her would be 
bewildered, but—
choice_data_list: (It'd be such a waste not to enjoy it...)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"My, what a troubled expression. Did you 
sense the Yamase wind blowing from 
somewhere?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... How considerate of them. Truly a 
person like a gentle, warming breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
“Still, walking through a dust storm is 
not something I am particularly fond of.”

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'm sheltering from the chilly autumn wind 
here for a bit. ...Mr. Pinwheel is 
watching over me, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking up at the sky, I saw a few 
pigeons. Flying freely, unlike the people 
on the ground— Watching them suddenly 
sparked an idea.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From a distance, one might finally be 
freed from the hustle and bustle.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ? You seem quite refreshed and radiant.
choice_data_list: Could you come with me for a second?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Well—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Voices of the crowd, singing voices, 
rising wind... The sounds weave together, 
like a symphony of wind instruments.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Even the round ones and the whirling ones 
are frolicking so happily...â

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Lu~, lululu~, lala~âª

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr's humming drifts along on 
the breeze. It has a gentle, joyful ring 
to it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. It's hard to believe the ground 
was rumbling just moments ago. I had such 
a lovely, peaceful time.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The round little ones seemed to be 
enjoying the melody as wellâoh?

text_block_list.name: Sparrow
text_block_list.text: (—Chirp, chirp chirp)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It seems it has become quite the 
lunchtime now.
choice_data_list: Should we go buy something to eat too?
Shall we go buy something to eat, too?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. In a place like this, I feel like I 
can savor a peaceful flavor."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to the melody played by so many 
sounds, I leisurely enjoyed the Fan 
Thanksgiving Festival.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. It's hard to believe the ground 
was rumbling just moments ago. I had such 
a lovely, peaceful time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (...*tap, tap, tap*)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—Oh? Could this sound be... the arrival of 
a cool breeze?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...—Ah. I knew it was you, Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hello to you too, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Miracle-san. Were you drawn in by 
the chirping as well?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. And also— because I heard a 
beautiful song.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's such a lovely sky, isn't it? I 
totally get why you'd want to sing.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... What a refreshingly cool person, 
just like a summer breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, would you care to join me? 
Entrusting ourselves to the wind, 
following our hearts.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, you're right. If I'm with you, 
Zephyr, I feel like I could sing with all 
my heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the festival bustle across the 
academy, the singing voices of the two 
carried on the wind. I spent a moment 
enjoying the gentle melody.
